title: Exact Cobordism Contraction and Succinct Block Cancellation
status: research draft with mathematical proofs and executable checks

claims.statement: Every compiled genus-zero plan factors through the square-free component algebra.
Exact rank formula including fixed-dot and closed-component zero cases.
For ordinary nonzero composition plans, observational equivalence is exactly equality under component projection; worst-case encoding requires 2^c bits.
claims.scope: Fixed plan; not a universal compressed morphism representation.

claims.statement: Contraction costs poly(b)*2^b bit operations instead of the current dense Cartesian-pair enumeration.
claims.attribution: Fast subset convolution is the established Bjoerklund-Husfeldt-Kaski-Koivisto algorithm.
claims.scope: The asymptotic algorithmic family is uncapped; implementation has declared allocation limits.

claims.statement: A matrix over R_b is invertible iff its augmentation is; radical correction nilpotence exponent is at most b+1 and sharp.
claims.warning: Scalar self-inverse units do not imply self-inverse matrix units.

claims.statement: A small radical interface determines the Schur update via four exact contractions.
claims.attribution: Specialization of standard low-rank inverse and Schur identities.

claims.statement: Supplied product-tensor interface maps permit exact cancellation without enumerating 2^m hidden generators.
claims.scope: Same-matching structured algebraic input; no general conversion from a knot diagram supplied.

claims.statement: A tensor product of invertible local backgrounds preserves product-tensor term counts under inverse application.
An explicit equality tensor requires exponentially many product terms under the specified flattening.
claims.scope: Representation obstruction; not exhibited as a knot-complex family or lower bound for arbitrary representations.

claims.statement: Common-order bounded-bond tensors admit polynomial-size exact pairings.
Quasi-polynomial recognition follows only after bounded descriptions, transitions, schedule construction, and decision certificates are supplied.
Paired finite measurements show dense-kernel improvements and sparse regressions. Ordinary diagram scans did not enter the dense path.
claims.scope: Source-derived current-engine fixtures, shared environment; not a production speedup guarantee.

claims.statement: 29 test methods passed, including exhaustive ring products, independent composition/scan checks, matrix and tensor checks.
The 2^40-dimensional structured algebraic certificate verifies via a 3-by-3 core.
